SEARCH
Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockStates

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockStates
public final class BedrockStates extends Object
Every block state name of Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release, typed: BoolState for byte 0/1 states, IntState for integers, EnumState for strings, with an enum in org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.state per distinct value set (states with the same values share one). Which values a block accepts is up to the block: BedrockBlockType.values(BedrockState).

Constants are added when Bedrock adds states; states Bedrock removes stay, deprecated.

Since:
1.0.0
